brief:
Israeli settlers have intensified attacks across the occupied West Bank, Al Jazeera English reported, with investigations pointing to systemic impunity as a driving factor. The pattern reflects persistent gaps in accountability for perpetrators of violence against Palestinian communities and property.

Settlers have targeted Palestinian villages and agricultural areas in repeated incidents that often go unpunished. Experts and rights groups attribute the escalation to weak enforcement mechanisms and minimal consequences for those responsible, creating conditions that enable further attacks.
dek: Impunity fuels surge in settler violence across occupied West Bank…
title: Settler violence surges across occupied West Bank amid impunity
